messages:
margot: Quick sync — holiday weeks incoming, proposing we keep biweekly release cadence but adjust cutoffs. Proposed rotation for release-owner over next 3 cycles: samir -> eli -> anika. Move branch cutoff to Tue 10:00am on the Thanksgiving week (hard cutoff). Thoughts? :spiral_calendar:

samir: OK with rotation. FYI any DB migrations need explicit sign-off from eng-sre. Also can we bump RC build window to 36h for flaky suites?

eli: prefer moving cutoff earlier (Mon 08:00) for holiday weeks so we have Monday run & rollback window.

anika: +1 to earlier cutoff. Also request release-bot sends changelog nudges 48h before cutoff and a final ping 2h before.

margot: noted. I'll set up release-bot reminders. Command I'll use:
```
/release schedule --cutoff 2026-11-24T08:00Z --reminders 48h,2h --owner @eli
```

release-bot: Reminder rule created: cutoff=2026-11-24T08:00Z, reminders=[48h,2h], channel=#eng-releases.

kevin: tagging runtime capacity — during holiday weeks we should pin smaller Dedicated pools or enable autoscale-burst. Adding note to calendar.

samir: on RC window: +1 if we can gate with flaky-test quarantine (tests marked flaky won't block release).

eli: +1 to quarantine gating. We need a clear owner to flip quarantine flags post-cutoff.

anika: I'll own quarantine flips for the next cycle.

margot: great. Coverage owners: samir(test infra), anika(api), kevin(runtime). I'll update the release-docs. Ping me if you need swap before EOD. :white_check_mark:

kevin: adding a short section to docs about holiday cutoffs & fallback routing. PR coming.

samir: can we also have an opt-in 'soft-freeze' label to warn teams 72h before cutoff?

margot: yes — creating label + automation to comment on open PRs. schedule: 72h soft-freeze, 48h changelog, 2h final.

release-ops: Acknowledged. We'll run a dry-run of the release calendar the week prior and validate holiday fallbacks.

margot: ok thanks everyone — I'll update calendar, docs, and create the reminder tickets. If you want to swap release ownership, DM me. :v:
